messages:
rachel: noticing a slow trickle of pending GPU pods in europe-north1. mostly 0.25/0.5 infer jobs scattering while a couple of 8GPU experiments remain blocked
soren: sounds like fragmentation. any recent scheduler flag flips?
rachel: we bumped the 'family-anchor-weight' last week to improve locality for some latency-sensitive inference, rollout id r2026-04-anchor-weight. suspect interaction with contiguous-slot preference
deepa: can you paste a pending pod and a short node summary?
rachel: pod snippet:
```
Name: infer-sm-301
requests.nvidia.com/gpu: 0.5
annotations: redwood/scheduler-hint=prefer-fastnic
Status: Pending (0/56 nodes fit: Insufficient contiguous gpus)
```
node snapshot (sanitized):
node-1: 8 contiguous free (anchor=legacy-family, last_touch=90m)
node-2: scattered 0.5s across hosts
node-3: 4 contiguous free

infra-bot: [alert] fragmentation_high europe-north1 unusable_gpus=30 anomaly=0.66 at 1801240005
soren: ok. immediate plan: 1) run targeted coalescer for fractional pods only (dry-run first) 2) lower prefer-fastnic hint weight in region to 0.4 3) reduce anchor TTL for non-critical families from 60m->10m
rachel: dry-run command: `infractl coalesce --region europe-north1 --filter "requests.gpu<=0.5" --strategy pack-same-family --dry-run`
(30s)
rachel: dry-run: would move ~14 pods, free 1x8 and 1x4 contiguous slots, let two 8GPU jobs schedule. recommends dont-evict-age<5m, max-evict=12%
oncall: approved conservative run. ensure evictions are staggered and we skip pods with pod-gang annotations
soren: also file INFRA-9220 to add fragmentation deltas to rollout canaries when changing anchor or hint weights
deepa: executing coalescer conservative now, watching events and OOMs
(2m later)
rachel: coalescer moved 12 pods, freed an 8 and a 4, both blocked experiments scheduled, pending decreased by ~60% :tada:
soren: great. please add a short follow-up: audit r2026-04-anchor-weight defaults and gate future weight changes on unusable_gpu metrics in canary dashboards
rachel: added INFRA-9220 notes and lowered anchor TTL for non-critical families. closing unless we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
